attestation.title: Access review sign-off
attestation.description: Record that the access review was carried out and its result accepted. The permissions computed below are the review's input; the sign-off is its record.

effective.title: Effective access
effective.description: Pick a user and a scope to see every permission they hold there and where each one comes from.
effective.showAll: Show permissions the user does not hold
effective.empty: Pick a user to see their effective permissions.
effective.wildcard: {{username}} holds a wildcard role, which grants every permission, including ones added later.
effective.breakGlass: {{username}} has an open break-glass session: every permission is granted until it ends.
effective.abac: Attribute policies are enforced on this install and can still deny a request these roles allow.
effective.overridesNote: Held is what route gates enforce: roles, approved elevations and break-glass. With overrides applies the per-user grant and deny overrides the way the policy engine does; route gates do not read overrides today.

catalog.exportFailed: The permission catalog could not be exported.

endpoints.title: Addresses to register with the identity provider
endpoints.intro: Register these addresses on the identity provider's side. They follow the public address McHarbor is reached on.
endpoints.oidcRedirectHint: Shared by every OpenID Connect provider on this install.
endpoints.samlAfterSave: The SAML ACS and metadata URLs contain the provider id, so they appear once the provider is saved.

metadata.title: Import IdP metadata
metadata.description: Paste the identity provider's SAML metadata URL or XML. McHarbor reads it, fills in the fields this plugin accepts, and shows the rest for you to check.
metadata.prefillReady: {{count}} field can be filled in from this metadata.
metadata.copyManually: This plugin has no field for these values, so copy them where the plugin asks for them.

reason.invalid_url: The metadata URL must be an http or https address.
reason.fetch_failed: The metadata URL could not be fetched. Check that McHarbor can reach it; the server log has the details.
reason.not_saml_metadata: This is not a SAML metadata document.
reason.no_idp_descriptor: The metadata describes no identity provider (no IDPSSODescriptor).
reason.input_missing: Enter a metadata URL or paste the XML.

preview.title: Preview group mapping
preview.description: Enter the groups a user would sign in with to see which McHarbor groups and roles they would get.
preview.useTestGroups: Use the {{count}} groups from the connection test
preview.noGroups: These groups lead to no McHarbor group.
preview.defaultRole: A newly provisioned user also gets the default role {{role}}.

impact.title: Who gains or loses roles
impact.summary: {{evaluated}} users evaluated from their last sign-in: {{changed}} would change, {{unchanged}} would not.
impact.unknown: Not evaluated, no sign-in recorded since group claims were tracked: {{users}}
impact.confirmDescription: These changes take effect for each user at their next sign-in.
impact.nextSignIn: Removing a mapping does not remove memberships it already created; only groups a mapping still names are kept in step with the provider.

wizard.defaultRoleHint: Given to accounts created by automatic provisioning.
wizard.fetchGroupsAfterSave: This provider can list its groups. Once it is saved, the edit dialog can fetch them for the mapping.

review.description: Check the settings before the provider is saved.
review.name: Name
review.disabledNote: The provider is saved disabled, so nobody can sign in with it until you enable it.

done.title: {{name}} is saved
done.description: Register the addresses below with the identity provider, then enable and test the connection.
done.enableFirst: Enable the provider to test the connection.
done.previewHint: Preview the mapping against real groups: run the connection test, or load the provider's groups.
